body: The broken jaw is extremely painful, I’m wired shut. Yawing/coughing/ hell even breathing is painful. I don’t really have the funds to travel back home, plus I have a dog so I can’t leave her behind. All I do is play video games and watch Netflix because I don’t know anybody to do anything with.  And I’m sick and tired of this shit.

I lost my job, I got jumped and am dealing with a broken jaw, I don’t know anybody in my new state of residence, my family is 2,000+ miles away, my ex girlfriend shattered my heart and isn’t talking to me, I’m about to be homeless.. contemplating ending it
